column3: “Lift the head” preserves the counting image behind “take a census”; “sons of Kohath” preserves the explicit descent wording.
“Everyone entering the service” names entry rather than explicitly qualifying the men as “qualified.”
“Cover it” retains the singular object after spreading the cloth “over them,” rather than repeating “them.”
The altar is named without the added material “bronze.”
“Do not cut off” preserves the direct active prohibition rather than “do not allow … to be cut off.”
“Lift the head” preserves the counting image behind “take a census.”
Separately lists “its covering” and “the covering of tachash over it,” rather than combining them into a single covering phrase.
“According to the mouth of Aaron and his sons” preserves the speaking image rendered “at the direction of.”
“In the hand of Ithamar” preserves the hand image rendered “under the direction of.”
